preconditions.description: The lengths of S1 and S2 are equal.
The length of S1 and S2 is between 1 and 31, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S1)
preconditions.description: All characters in S1 are lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S2)
preconditions.description: All characters in S2 are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The function returns True if S2 is a scrambled form of S1, otherwise False. This is a necessary and sufficient condition based on the definition of scrambled strings.
